title: APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION AS A LOCAL CARDIO-CEREBROVASCULAR, CARDIOVASCULAR, OR CEREBROVASCULAR DISEASE CENTER

APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION AS A LOCAL CARDIO-CEREBROVASCULAR, CARDIOVASCULAR, OR CEREBROVASCULAR DISEASE CENTER
Form No. 5 attached to the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Cardio-Cerebrovascular Diseases <Newly inserted on June 22, 2023>

Local center applied for:
[ ] Cardio-cerebrovascular disease center
[ ] Cardiovascular disease center
[ ] Cerebrovascular disease center

The applicant must not complete the shaded fields. Mark the applicable boxes [ ] with a check (√).

Local center

[ ] Cerebrovascular disease center
Designation type: [ ] Integrated  [ ] Surgical  [ ] Interventional procedure
Name of representative: __________
License number: __________
Name of person responsible for practical affairs: __________
Telephone number: __________

I hereby apply, as stated above, for designation as a local [ ] cardio-cerebrovascular disease center, [ ] cardiovascular disease center, or [ ] cerebrovascular disease center under Article 13 of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Cardio-Cerebrovascular Diseases and Article 8 of its Enforcement Rule.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Applicant: ____________________ (Signature or seal)

To: Minister of Health and Welfare

Documents to attach
Documents proving compliance with the designation criteria in each subparagraph of Article 8 (1) of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Cardio-Cerebrovascular Diseases.

Fee: None.

Processing procedure
1. Preparation of application — Applicant.
2. Receipt — Ministry of Health and Welfare.
3. Review — Ministry of Health and Welfare.
4. Approval — Ministry of Health and Welfare.
5. Issue of designation certificate — Ministry of Health and Welfare.

210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m² (recycled material)]
